MRF.about: Madras Rubber Factory Limited (MRF) is the parent company of the MRF Group. The Co is engaged in the business of manufacturing tyres
MRF.points:
Products & Services
1) Products: The company manufactures tyres for passenger cars, 2W, 3W, OTRs, trucks, farm tractors, LCVs, tubes & flaps, SCVs, pickup cars, MCVs and ICVs. It also manufactures sports goods, paints & coats and pretreads, etc and supplies puzzles, games, and toys for kids through its brand Funskool.

APOLLOTYRE.about: Apollo, established in 1972, manufactures automatic bias and radial tyres, and tubes. It has plants in Kochi, Vadodara, Pune, and Chennai. The product profile includes prominent tyre brands in the T&B, light truck, passenger car, and farm vehicle segments in India, catering to both original equipment manufacturers, and the replacement market.
APOLLOTYRE.points:
Market Position
The company is one of India's largest tyre manufacturers by revenue, holding a prominent position in the domestic truck and bus radial, truck and bus bias, and passenger car radial tyre segments, and is among the top 3 players in PCR and the 2nd-largest in TBR by market share.

CEATLTD.about: CEAT, established in 1958, is one of the largest tyre manufacturers and one of the fastest-growing tyre companies in India. CEAT became a part of the RPG Group in 1982. It is amongst the Top 25 best workplaces in Manufacturing by GPTW for 2022.
CEATLTD.points:
History of CEAT
CEAT was founded in 1924 by Virginio Bruni Tedeschi as Cavi Elettrici e Affini Torino, initially producing electrical and telephone cables. During World War II, it diversified into rubber and began manufacturing tires in 1945. CEAT Tyres of India was established in 1958 in collaboration with the Tatas, setting up its first factory in Mumbai. In 1981, the RPG Group acquired CEAT, India's leading conglomerate with 30,000+ employees, a presence in 110+ countries, and annual gross revenues of USD 4.4 Bn

BALKRISIND.about: Balkrishna Industries Limited (BKT) started its Off-Highway tyre business in 1987. For over 30 years, BKT has successfully focused on specialist segments such as agricultural, construction and industrial as well as earthmoving, port and mining, ATV, and gardening applications.
BALKRISIND.points:
Product Portfolio
The company is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of “Off-Highway Tires” catering to specialty segments like Agricultural, Mining, Construction, Industrial, Earthmover, Port, ATV, and Turf care applications in both cross-ply and radial construction. It has a product range with more than 3,600 SKUs.

JKTYRE.about: JK Tyre & Industries is the flagship company of the JK group which is headed by Dr R P Singhania as its chairman and managing director. It is a one of the leading tyre manufacturers in India and amongst the top 25 manufacturers in the world with a wide range of products catering to diverse business segments that includes Truck/Bus, LCV (Light commercial vehicles), Passenger Cars, MUV (Multi utility vehicles) and Tractors.
JKTYRE.points:
Leadership
- Pioneer of radial technology in India and No. 1 Truck/Bus Radial (TBR) manufacturer.
- 1st company in India with OE fitment of tubeless passenger radials.
- 1st in India to launch high-performance H, V and Z-rated passenger radial tyres.
- First in India to launch Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) based on sensor
technology.
- 19th Ranked top tyre company Globally

MARUTI.about:
The Company was established in 1981. A joint venture agreement was signed between the Government of India and Suzuki Motor
Corporation (SMC), Japan in 1982. The Company became a subsidiary of SMC in 2002.It is the market leader in passenger vehicle segment in India. In terms of production volume and sales, the Company is now SMC’s largest subsidiary. SMC currently holds 56.28% of its equity stake.
The principal activities of the Company are manufacturing, purchase and sale of motor vehicles, components and spare parts.
MARUTI.points:
Segment wise domestic sales 9M FY26
Compact - 41.6%
Utility vehicles - 37.7%
Vans - 7.3%
Mini - 5.3%
Mid Size - 0.1%
LCV - 2%
Sales to other (OEM) - 6%

M&M.about:
Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd is one of the most diversified automobile company in India with presence across 2-wheelers, 3-wheelers, PVs, CVs, tractors & earthmovers.
It also has presence across financial services, auto components, hospitality, infrastructure, retail, logistics, steel trading and processing, IT businesses, agri, aerospace, consulting services, defence, energy and industrial equipment through its subsidiaries and group companies.
It was incorporated in 1945 by Ghulam Mohammad and two Mahindra Brothers (KC & JC Mahindra) and was later renamed as Mahindra & Mahindra in 1948.
M&M.points:
Business Positioning:
M&M is the flagship company of the Mahindra Group, with core businesses in mobility products and farm solutions. The co. is:
- #1 SUV player with 25% revenue market share
- #2 PV player by revenue market share
- #1 LCV (<3.5T) player with 52% volume share
- #1 E-SUV player with 40.6% revenue market share
E-SUVs now form 12% of M&M's SUV volumes.

BAJAJ-AUTO.about:
Bajaj Auto, the flagship company of Bajaj
Group, is a two-wheeler and three-wheeler manufacturing company that exports to 79 countries across several countries in Latin America, Southeast Asia, and many more.
Its headquarter is in Pune, India.
The company has acquired 76% of the KTM Brand which manufactures sports and super sports two-wheelers, which was 14% in 2007 when the company first acquired KTM.
BAJAJ-AUTO.points:
Business Overview:
Bajaj Auto develops, manufactures, and sells
2-wheelers, 3-wheelers, quadricycles, and
parts and accessories. Automotive accounted
for 97% of standalone revenue and its segments are Automotive, Financing, and Investments.
The company's wholesale customers are
mainly dealers and distributors, with 2,598
of them accounting for 99% of FY26 sales.
Bajaj Auto Credit supports retail sales through captive financing.

HEROMOTOCO.about:
Hero Moto Corp earlier also known as “Hero Honda” is one of India’s first motorcycle manufacturers.
The company started in 1984 as a Technological collaboration with Honda, Japan. Before this collaboration, Hero was selling Cycles under the brand name, Hero Cycles.
In 2011, Honda group sold its 26% stake in the company to the Munjals (promoters) and ended the JV. Post the termination of JV, the name of the company was changed to Hero Motocorp.
HEROMOTOCO.points:
Products & Brands
a) Premia: Hero Premia is a premium retail and service experience offering a range of motorcycles and scooters, including Harley-Davidson X440, Vida electric scooters, Mavrick 440, Xpulse, Karizma, and Xtreme.

EICHERMOT.about:
Eicher Motors Limited, incorporated in 1982, is the listed company of the Eicher Group in India and a leading player in the Indian automobile industry and the global leader in middleweight motorcycles.
Eicher has a joint venture with Sweden’s AB Volvo to create Volvo Eicher Commercial Vehicles Limited (VECV). VECV is engaged in truck and bus operations, auto components business, and technical consulting services business
EICHERMOT.points:
Business Verticals
A) Royal Enfield:
The company manufactures and markets motorcycles under the Royal Enfield brand. Its portfolio includes motorcycles such as the Classic 350, Bullet 350, Meteor 350, Hunter 350, Scram series, and Himalayan 450, along with riding gear, lifestyle apparel, and motorcycle accessories.

ASHOKLEY.about:
Ashok Leyland is the flagship Company of the Hinduja group, having a long-standing presence in the domestic medium and heavy commercial vehicle (M&HCV) segment. The company has a strong brand and well-diversified distribution and service network across the country and has a presence in 50 countries, it is one of the most fully-integrated manufacturing companies. Its headquarter is in Chennai
They manage driver training institutes across India and have trained over 8,00,000 drivers since inception.
ASHOKLEY.points:
Market Leadership:
The company is India’s 2nd-largest manufacturer of medium and heavy commercial vehicles (M&HCVs) and the 2nd-largest player in the 2-4 tons LCV segment. Globally, it is the 4th-largest bus manufacturer and 19th-largest truck manufacturer. Its M&HCV truck market share is around 30% in FY26.

TVSMOTOR.about: TVS Motor Company Ltd (TVSM) is engaged in manufacturing two-wheelers and its accessories; it currently manufactures a wide range of two-wheelers and three-wheelers.
TVSMOTOR.points:
Overview
The company is in the 2-wheeler industry and is the only company to have a presence in all 3 categories, i.e., motorcycles, scooters, and mopeds, catering to both domestic and international markets. It is also the only company to have a presence in the moped segment for the domestic market.

EXIDEIND.about: Exide Industries Ltd is primarily engaged in the manufacturing of storage batteries and allied products in India.
EXIDEIND.points:
Products
The company offers a diversified product portfolio, with batteries from 2.5Ah to 20,200Ah.
1) B2C Aftermarket: The company manufactures batteries for 2W, 3W, 4W, E-rickshaws, UPS, and solar for trade and aftermarket.
2) Institutional B2B:The company manufactures batteries for 2W, 3W, and 4W OEMs. In the infrastructure segment, it serves industries such as telecom, railways, power projects, traction, data centers, and industrial UPS. Additionally, it manufactures specialized batteries for submarines.
3) International Business: It manufactures automotive, traction, and UPS batteries. It has a presence in over 60 countries with nearly 8% of the standalone revenue. In FY25, onboarded 14 distributors for automotive batteries and 28 accounts for industrial batteries.

BOSCHLTD.about: Bosch Ltd has presence across automotive technology, industrial technology, consumer goods and energy and building technology. It manufactures and trades in products such as diesel and gasoline fuel injection systems, automotive aftermarket products, industrial equipment, electrical power tools, security systems and industrial and consumer energy products and solutions.
BOSCHLTD.points:
Mobility Solutions
1. Powertrain Solutions :
It offers integrated solutions in the market segments - electric vehicles, passenger cars, Commercial vehicles, off-road vehicles, etc. This includes 2-wheeler and powersports, ICE and Electrification.
The power solutions showed a growth of ~18% and 2-Wheeler showed a growth of ~69% in FY26.

SUNPHARMA.about: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, developing and marketing a wide range of branded and generic formulations and Active Pharma Ingredients (APIs). The company and its subsidiaries has various manufacturing facilities spread across the world with trading and other incidental and related activities extending to global market. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India.
SUNPHARMA.points:
Product Offerings:
The company produces a range of
generic and specialty medications
for chronic and acute conditions.
Its product portfolio includes
generics, branded generics,
specialty pharmaceuticals,
advanced technology-based
products, antiretrovirals, active
pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs),
and intermediates. It offers medications
in multiple dosage forms, such as injectables, sprays, ointments, creams, liquids, tablets,
and capsules. The company offers 27 products in the global specialty market, with a strategic focus on dermatology, ophthalmology, and onco-dermatology segments.

CIPLA.about: Incorporated in 1935, Cipla Ltd is in the business of manufacturing, developing, and marketing a wide range of branded and generic formulations and APIs
CIPLA.points:
Geographical Split FY26:
One India - 45%
North America - 24%
One Africa - 15%
EMEU - 13%
Others - 3%

DRREDDY.about: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd is a leading India-based pharmaceutical company which offers a portfolio of products and services, including Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Custom Pharmaceutical services (CPS), generics, biosimilars and differentiated formulations.
DRREDDY.points:
Market Leadership: # https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/95588392-8071-413a-9d78-991bd1d87d4a.pdf#page=13 #}
The company is a player in the Indian Pharmaceutical Market (IPM), ranked No. 10, with strong therapy leadership, including the #1 position in stemmatological and #2 in vaccines. It also has 15 brands featured among the IPM Top 300.

APOLLOHOSP.about:
Apollo Hospitals was established in 1983 by Dr. Prathap C Reddy, renowned architect of modern healthcare in India. As the nation’s first corporate hospital, Apollo Hospitals is acclaimed for pioneering the private healthcare revolution in the country.
Apollo Hospitals has emerged as Asia’s foremost integrated healthcare services provider and has a robust presence across the healthcare ecosystem, including Hospitals, Pharmacies,
Primary Care & Diagnostic Clinics and several Retail Health models.
APOLLOHOSP.points:
Business Segments:
a) Healthcare Services (50% in FY26 vs 55% in FY22):
The company has a capacity of 10,970 beds in 78 hospitals located in India and overseas, out of which 9,481 beds are located in 49 owned hospitals, 699 beds in Day Surgery & Cradles and 790 beds are in 6 managed hospitals.
b) Digital Health & Pharmacy Distribution (43% in FY26 vs 37% in FY22):
The WOS Apollo HealthCo (AHL) manages
India’s largest organized pharmacy network, operating across 22 states and 5 union territories, with a presence in 1,200 cities and towns. It has 7,289 active stores. Sales from its offline private and generic labels contribute 15.3% of the total revenue (Q4FY26). Additionally, its online platform, Apollo 24x7, has over 47 million registered users and 9 lakh daily active users.
c) Retail Health & Diagnostics (7% in FY26 vs 8% in FY22):
The WOS Apollo Health & Lifestyle operates 2,501 diagnostics centers, 167 dialysis centers, 280 dental centers, and 316 clinics. As of FY26, the segment has a footfall of 33,461 per day and an average gross realization per patient of Rs. 1,608.

DABUR.about: Dabur is India’s leading FMCG, Ayurvedic and natural health care company with wide network distribution across world.
DABUR.points:
Market Position
The company is one of India's leading FMCG companies, with products reaching 8 out of 10 Indian households. Its portfolio comprises 3 brands with revenues above Rs. 1,000 Cr, 3 brands above Rs. 500 Cr, and 16 brands in the Rs. 100-500 Cr revenue range.

HINDUNILVR.about: Hindustan Unilever is in the FMCG business comprising primarily of Home Care, Beauty & Personal Care and Foods & Refreshment segments. The Company has manufacturing facilities across the country and sells primarily in India.
HINDUNILVR.points:
Business Segments & Brand Portfolio
The company has a portfolio of over 50 brands, spanning 15 FMCG categories. The products are split into the following segments:

ITC.about: Established in 1910, ITC is the largest cigarette manufacturer and seller in the country. ITC operates in four business segments at present — FMCG Cigarettes, FMCG Others, Paperboards, Paper and Packaging, and Agri Business.

NESTLEIND.about: Nestle India Limited is a subsidiary of Nestle which is a Swiss MNC. The company operates in the Food segment.
NESTLEIND.points:
Parentage
As of FY26, Switzerland-based Nestlé S.A., the world's largest food and beverage company, held a 62.76% stake in the company. It has access to the parent company's global portfolio of brands, proprietary technologies, and advanced R&D capabilities.

BRITANNIA.about: Britannia Industries is one of Indias leading food companies with a 100 year legacy and annual revenues in excess of Rs. 16000 Cr. Britannia is among the most trusted food brands, and manufactures Indias favorite brands like Good Day, Tiger, NutriChoice, Milk Bikis and Marie Gold which are household names in India. Britannias product portfolio includes Biscuits, Bread, Cakes, Rusk, and Dairy products including Cheese, Beverages, Milk and Yoghurt.
BRITANNIA.points:
Part of Wadia Group:
Britannia Industries belongs to the Wadia
Group, a reputed Indian Business house
who has presence in a wide range of
business segments like Airlines (Go
Air), Realty (Bombay Realty), Textiles
(Bombay Dyeing) and Plantations and
other business (Bombay Burmah trading
Corporation which is also the Ultimate
holding company of Britannia Industries)

TATACONSUM.about:
Tata Consumer Products Ltd. is part
of Tata Group and is engaged in the
food & beverages segment globally.
TATACONSUM.points:
Business Overview
Tata Consumer Products operates globally in food and beverages, spanning packaged drinks and a diverse food portfolio. Its 2020 acquisition of Tata Chemicals' consumer business expanded its reach into staples like salt, pulses, spices, oils, ready-to-eat meals, and alternative proteins.

MARICO.about: Marico Limited is one of India's leading consumer goods companies, operating across beauty, personal care, wellness and foods in India and select international markets. Portfolio includes Parachute, Saffola, Hair & Care, Nihar, Livon, Set Wet, Beardo, Just Herbs, True Elements, Plix, Cosmix and 4700BC; products reach 1 out of 3 Indians.
MARICO.points:
Product Portfolio:
The product categories that the company caters to in the domestic market and the brands of the company :
a) Coconut Oil - Parachute
b) Super Premium Refined Edible Oils - Saffola
c) Cold Pressed Edible Oils - Saffola Cold Pressed Oils
d) Value-Added Hair Oils- Parachute Advansed Jasmine, Coconut Enriched Hair Oils, Amla variants and Hair & Care Almond
e) Foods & Nutrition - Saffola Foods, True Elements, Coco Soul, Plix, Cosmix and 4700BC
f) Premium Personal Care - premium hair nourishment, male grooming, hair cleansing and skin care
g) Digital-First Premium Personal Care - Beardo, Just Herbs and Plix Personal Care
Market Share MAT - Jun-26:
Parachute Rigids 59%
-Saffola Oats 42%,
-Value Added Hair Oils 29%,
-Post-wash Leave-on Serums 44%,
-Hair Gels/Waxes/Creams 51%
Each ranked #1 in respective category

COLPAL.about: Colgate-Palmolive India Ltd is engaged in manufacturing/ trading of toothpaste, tooth powder, toothbrush, mouthwash and personal care products.
COLPAL.points:
Business Overview:
Co. is the country's dominant oral care company operating across toothpaste, toothbrush, mouthwash, and personal care (Palmolive). Its 4 growth pillars are:
- Lead Toothpaste Category Growth,
- Transformative Accelerate Oral Care
- Premiumisation, Lead Category Growth
in Toothbrush, and
- Build Personal Care.

ASIANPAINT.about: Asian Paints is the largest home decor company in India. The 80+yr old company has major brands like Asian Paints, Apco, etc under its umbrella. The co. is into wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, wall stickers, mechanized tools, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lightings, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.

BERGEPAINT.about: Berger Paints India is engaged in the Manufacturing and selling of Paints.(Source : 201903 Annual Report Page No: 117)
BERGEPAINT.points:
Market Position:
Berger is the 2nd largest paint company in India, 4th largest in Asia and 7th largest decorative paints company in the world. Berger has operations across India, Poland, Russia and Nepal. Portfolio spans decorative paints, construction chemicals, waterproofing, wood coatings, protective coatings, automotive, general industrial and powder coatings. Group has 17 active subsidiaries/JVs

ULTRACEMCO.about: UltraTech Cement is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of Cement and Cement related product primarily across globe.
ULTRACEMCO.points:
Market Leadership
The company is the 3rd largest cement company in the world, excluding China. It is also the largest cement manufacturer in India with a 28% share of the grey cement capacity.

AMBUJACEM.about: Ambuja Cements Ltd. is among the leading cement companies in India. It is a member of the Adani Group. Currently, Ambuja Cement has a cement capacity of 31 million tonnes with six integrated cement manufacturing plants and eight cement grinding units across the country.
AMBUJACEM.points:
Promoter group
Ambuja Cement is a part of the Adani group. The group owns Ambuja Cement, ACC and Sanghi Cements, Penna & Orient Cement in the cement sector. Adani group has businesses in various sectors like Energy & Utility, Transport & Logistics, Materials, Metal & Mining, Incubator and Specialty. Adani cement has 16.6% market share as of Q2 FY26.

SUPREMEIND.about:
Supreme Industries Limited is India’s leading plastics product manufacturer, offering a wide and comprehensive range of plastic products in India. The company operates in various product categories viz. Plastic Piping System, Cross Laminated Films & Products, Protective Packaging Products, Industrial Moulded Components, Moulded Furniture, Storage & Material Handling Products, Performance
Packaging Films and Composite LPG Cylinders.
SUPREMEIND.points:
Business Segments
1) Plastic Piping Products (67% in 9M FY25 vs 66% in FY23): The company is India's leading manufacturer of plastic piping solutions, offering 14,000+ SKUs across products like uPVC pipes, injection moulded PVC fittings, handmade fittings, HDPE pipe systems, etc for diverse applications in plumbing, water tanks, fire protection, drainage, and more. In 9M FY25, the segment was impacted by unfavourable PVC resin prices and slower-than-expected demand recovery from infrastructure spending.

ASTRAL.about: Astral Poly Technik Ltd was established in 1996, with the aim to manufacture pro-India plumbing and drainage systems in the country. The company is into manufacturing of Pipes, water tanks, bathware, specialised valves, paints, adhesives and sealants, infrastructure solutions, specialised fittings and construction chemicals.
ASTRAL.points:
Business Segments:
a) Plumbing (71% in FY26 vs 73% in FY24):
The company offers PVC, CPVC and lead-free PVC plumbing systems and fittings including drainage systems, agriculture systems, fire sprinkler systems, Industrial and urban infrastructure piping systems, specialized fittings, water tanks, cable protection system etc.
It is among India's leading players in the high-margin CPVC pipes and fittings business.
b) Paints and Adhesives (29% in FY26 vs 27% in FY24):
The company offers adhesives, sealants, specialized valves, construction chemicals,
and other infrastructure products. It also offers
a range of paints including Interior Emulsion, Exterior Emulsion, Primers, Putty bags Wall putty, Stainers & Colorants, etc under the Astral Paints brand. The company has also entered the D2C segment with DIY segment with brand name BondTite and BondCraft. The company also offers flooring solutions like waterproffing, grouting etc.
c) Bathware:
The company has started manufacturing
for bathware as well. It manufactures premium
as well as mid-range toilet seats, wash basins, faucets and premium range diverters and body jets.
The segment delivered 27.3% sales growth in FY26.

KAJARIACER.about: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd is primarily engaged in manufacturing and trading of ceramic and vitrified tiles in India. It is the largest manufacturer of ceramic/ vitrified tiles in India and 8th largest in the world.
KAJARIACER.points:
Product Portfolio
Their product portfolio includes ceramic wall & floor tiles, polished & glazed vitrified tiles, bath-ware solutions, and plywood & laminates. In FY23, tiles accounted for ~88% of revenues while the rest of products accounted for ~12% of revenues

TATASTEEL.about:
Tata Steel Ltd is Asia's first integrated private steel company setup in 1907.
The company has presence across the entire value chain of steel manufacturing from mining and processing iron ore and coal to producing and distributing finished products.
The company has a target to increase domestic steelmaking capacity to 30 MnTPA by 2025.
TATASTEEL.points:
Products and Brands:
The company manufactures flat products
like HR coils, CR coils, galvanised steel, and
long products like wire rods, rebars, ferro alloys, tubes, bearings, wires, etc.
Its products are sold under 20 brands, including Tata Astrum, Tata Tiscon, Galvano, Tata Steelium, Tata Structura, Tata Agrico, Tata Wiron, Tata Pravish, etc.

JSWSTEEL.about:
JSW Steel is primarily engaged in the business of manufacture and sale of Iron and Steel Products.
It is the flagship business of the diversified, US$ 23 billion JSW Group.The Group has interests in energy, infrastructure, cement, paints, sports, and venture capital.
JSWSTEEL.points:
Parentage:
The company is the flagship entity
of the JSW Group which operates across various sectors, including energy, infrastructure, cement, paints, real estate, digital platforms, mobility, defense, sports, and venture capital.

HINDALCO.about:
Incorporated in 1958, Hindalco Industries Ltd. is a flagship company of the Aditya Birla Group. The Co and its subsidiaries are primarily engaged in the production of Aluminium and Copper. It is also
engaged in the manufacturing of aluminium sheet, extrusion and light gauge products for use in packaging markets like beverage and food, can and foil products, etc.
HINDALCO.points:
Business Segments:
a) Novelis (63% in Q1 FY27 vs 61% in Q1 FY26):
The segment comprises Novelis Inc., a wholly owned foreign subsidiary of the company, along with its step-down subsidiaries, which manufacture and sell aluminium sheet and light-gauge products across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. Novelis is the world’s leading producer of automotive and beverage can sheet. It is also the world’s largest aluminium recycler. The segment reported a total shipment of 916 KT in Q1 FY27 vs 963 KT in Q1 FY26.
b) Copper (20% in Q1 FY27 vs 23% in Q1 FY26):
The copper business manufactures copper cathodes, copper rods, precious metals and di-ammonium phosphate (DAP). It serves more than half of the country’s refined copper demand and is also the world’s 2nd-largest producer of copper rods.
Sales (KT):
-Metal: 105 in Q1 FY27 vs 124 in Q1 FY26
-CC Rods: 96 in Q1 FY27 vs 104 in Q1 FY26
c) Aluminium (17% in Q1 FY27 vs 16% in Q1 FY26):
The aluminium business operates a fully integrated value chain covering bauxite mining,
alumina refining, aluminium smelting, casting and downstream manufacturing. Its product portfolio includes alumina, aluminium ingots, billets, wire rods, and high-value downstream products such as flat rolled products, extrusions, and foils. The company is India’s only fully integrated aluminium player, Asia’s largest producer of primary aluminium and one of the country’s largest downstream aluminium producers.
Sales (KT):
-Upstream: 335 in Q1 FY27 vs 325

COALINDIA.about: Coal India Ltd is mainly engaged in mining and production of Coal and also operates Coal washeries. The major consumers of the company are power and steel sectors. Consumers from other sectors include cement, fertilizers, brick kilns
COALINDIA.points:
A Maharatna Company
The company was incorporated in 1972 as Coal Mines Authority Limited and renamed CIL in November 1975 following the nationalisation of the coal sector. It is a Maharatna CPSE under the Ministry of Coal and has 9 wholly owned subsidiaries, 5 other subsidiaries, and 5 joint ventures, including a foreign subsidiary. The Government of India’s stake declined from 63% as of Mar 2026 to 61% in Jun 2026 following the OFS, in which it sold a total of 2% stake.

RELIANCE.about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.
RELIANCE.points:
Architecture
Reliance Industries Limited holds key business stakes, including 66.43% in Jio Platforms (RJIL). Additionally, it maintains an 83.56% ownership each in Reliance Retail Ventures and Reliance Consumer Products, alongside a 59.59% holding in JioStar.

ONGC.about: ONGC is the largest crude oil and natural gas Company in India, contributing around 71 per cent to Indian domestic production
ONGC.points:
Business Overview:
The company is India’s largest crude oil and natural gas company, with in-house capabilities across the exploration and production of Oil and Gas and related oil-field services. Its crude oil serves as a key raw material for downstream companies like IOC, BPCL, HPCL and MRPL, which process it into products including petrol, diesel, kerosene, naphtha and LPG. It has produced 2,152 MMTOE of oil and gas to
date. In FY26, the company produced 73%
of India’s crude oil and 57% of its natural gas, accounting for 64.3% of the country’s total hydrocarbon output.

NTPC.about: NTPC (National Thermal Power Corporation) Ltd along with its subsidiaries/ associates & JVs is primarily involved in generation and sale of bulk power to State power utilities. Other business of the group includes providing consultancy, project management & supervision, energy trading, oil & gas exploration and coal mining.
NTPC.points:
Business Segments - FY26:
a) Generation (94):
The company is the largest power-generating company in India with an aggregate installed capacity of 89,108 MW, constituting 17% of India’s total installed capacity. It owns 53 power stations across India (27 coal-based, 7 gas-based, 1 Hydro, 1 Wind, 17 Solar, and 1 Small hydro plant). It is a major player in coal-based thermal generation in India.

TATAPOWER.about: Tata Power Company Ltd is primarily involved in the business of the generation, transmission and distribution of electricity. It aims to produce electricity completely through renewable sources. It also manufactures solar roofs and plans to build 1 lakh ev charging stations by 2025 The company is India's largest vertically-integrated power company.

HAVELLS.about:
Havells India Limited is a leading Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) Company and a major power distribution equipment manufacturer with a strong global presence.
It enjoys enviable market dominance across a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Air Conditioners, Electric Water Heaters, Power Capacitors, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications.
HAVELLS.points:
Product Segments
The company offers 24 products verticals, under the following segments:
1) Cables (~39% in FY26 vs ~33% in FY25): The company offers flexible and power cables including multicore round cable, flat submersible cable, LAN cable, CCTV, speaker cable, etc.
2) Lloyd Consumer (~18% in FY26 vs ~24% in FY25): Lloyd offers air conditioners, washing machines, refrigerators and televisions.
3) Electrical Consumer Durables (~17% in FY26 vs ~18% in FY25): It offers fans, appliances and water heaters.
4) Switchgears (~12% in FY26 vs 11% in FY25): The company offers domestic switchgears, capacitors, switches, industrial switchgears, etc.
5) Lighting & Fixtures (~7% in FY26 vs ~8% in FY25): Comprises of professional and consumer luminaries including Home Art lights, LED panels, LED Cobs, lamps, batten, etc.
6) Others (~8% in FY26 vs ~24% in FY25): Includes motors, solar, pump & water purifiers, personal grooming products, etc.

POLYCAB.about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application. More recently Polycab has also launched a wide range of consumer electrical products like Fans, Switches, Switchgear, LED lights and Luminaries, Solar Inverters, and Pumps.
POLYCAB.points:
Business Segments
a) Wires & Cables (87% in FY26 vs 84% in FY25):
The company is India’s leading manufacturer of wires and cables, including flexible wires, building wires, optical fiber cables, rubber cables, control cables, and special-purpose cables, etc. It offers over 9,650 SKUs across retail and industrial applications and commands a 30-31% share of the organized domestic market.

VOLTAS.about:
Voltas is engaged in the business of air conditioning, refrigeration, electro - mechanical projects as an EPC contractor both in domestic and international geographies (Middle East and Singapore) and engineering product services for mining, water management and treatment, construction equipments and textile industry.
Voltas was created 6 decades ago when Tata Sons joined hands with a swiss company Volkart Brothers. Voltas is also one of the most reputed engineering solution providers specializing in project management.
The company has 5,000+ Customer sites actively managed across India
VOLTAS.points:
Leadership
Number 1 Room AC Brand in India

WHIRLPOOL.about: Whirlpool of India Ltd is one of the leading manufacturers and marketers of major home appliances in the country.
WHIRLPOOL.points:
Parent Company:
Promoted by Whirlpool Corp.,
USA, the company is a global
kitchen and laundry appliances
manufacturer. Its brand portfolio
includes Whirlpool, KitchenAid,
Maytag, Consum, Brastemp, and
Amana. In 2023, it reported sales
of approximately $19 billion and operates
55 manufacturing and technology research centers.

DIXON.about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited, incorporated in 1993 , is a Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) company with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras (CCTVs), and mobile phones. It also undertakes reverse logistics operations. Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India.
DIXON.points:
Business Segments:
a) Mobile & EMS Division (90% in FY26 vs 85% in FY25):
The company has emerged as the fastest-growing EMS company by revenue and market capitalisation. It manufactures feature phones, smartphones, IT hardware, Telecom, hearables & wearables. Its key client in this segment includes Samsung.
b) Consumer Electronics & Appliances (6% in FY26 vs 9% in FY25):
The company offers LED TVs (32-98 inches), Smart TVs, Monitors, IFPD Commercial displays, Digital signage PCB & LCM panel assembly, and LED Bar Injection moulding. It is the largest Original Design Manufacturing (OEM & ODM) company in India, and has a 37% share in outsourced manufacturing. Its clients include Xiaomi, Samsung, Hisense, Panasonic, Acer, Toshiba, BPL, Lloyd, VU, Motorola, etc.
c) Home Appliances (3% in FY26 vs 4% in FY25):
The company is an ODM/OEM in India, manufacturing Semi-Automatic Washing Machines (SAWM) and Fully Automatic Top
Load (FATL) models for both domestic and
global markets, holding about 35% market
share in SAWM and around 15% in the FATL segment. It offers a product range of 175+ SAWM models and 20+ FATL models. Its
clientele includes Bosch, Godrej, Voltas
-Beko, BPL, Sharp, Onida, Reliance,
Flipkart, Croma, and Lloyd, etc.
d) Lighting Products (1% in FY26 vs 2% in FY25):
The company offers a range of LED products, including lamps, battens, panels, strip and rope lights, downlighters, street and flood lights, and smart lighting solutions, with 2,000+ variants across consumer

BHARTIARTL.about:
Bharti Airtel Ltd is one of the world’s leading providers of telecommunication services with presence in 18 countries representing India, Sri
Lanka, 14 countries in Africa.
BHARTIARTL.points:
Segments & Presence
Mobile, Broadband, DTH and Bank.
The company has operations in India, Africa, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.

TCS.about: Tata Consultancy Services is the flagship company and a part of Tata group. It is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world's largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions.
TCS.points:
Revenue Breakup (Q2 FY27):
- BFSI: 32.8%
- Consumer Business: 14.9%
- Life Sciences & Healthcare: 10.3%
- Manufacturing: 9.0%
- Technology & Services: 8.6%
- Energy, Resources & Utilities: 6.2%
- Communication & Media: 5.8%
- Regional Markets & Others: 12.4%

INFY.about: Infosys Ltd provides consulting, technology, outsourcing and next-generation digital services to enable clients to execute strategies for their digital transformation. It is the 2nd largest Information Technology company in India behind TCS.
INFY.points:
Digital Services:
It comprises of services and solution offerings
of the group that enables clients to transform their businesses. It includes offerings that enhance customer experience, leverage
AI-based analytics and big data, engineer
digital products and IoT, modernize legacy
tech systems, migrate to cloud applications
and implement advanced cyber-security systems.

HDFCBANK.about:
HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024.
As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges.
HDFCBANK.points:
Market Position:
The company is India's one of the 3 systemically important banks with a 15% market share in the banking sector’s advances and a 37% market share in the private sector banks’ advances as of FY24. It is also the second-largest bank in India.
It is among the top 3 Government Banks collecting direct and indirect taxes for the Government of India.
It is a market leader in almost every asset category.

ICICIBANK.about: ICICI Bank is the second-largest private sector bank in India offering a diversified portfolio of financial products and services to retail, SME and corporate customers. The Bank has an extensive network of branches, ATMs and other touch-points.The ICICI group has presence in businesses like life and general insurance, housing finance, primary dealership, etc, through its subsidiaries and associates.
ICICIBANK.points:
Ratios Q3 FY26
Capital Adequacy Ratio - 17.11%
Net Interest Margin - 4.30%
Gross NPA - 1.53%
Net NPA - 0.37%
CASA Ratio - 39%

BAJFINANCE.about: Bajaj Finance is mainly engaged in the business of lending. BFL has a diversified lending portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers with a significant presence in urban and rural India. It also accepts public and corporate deposits and offers variety of financial services products to its customers.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:124)
BAJFINANCE.points:
Business Overview:
The company is India's largest private-sector Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), catering to both individual and business customers through a portfolio of financial products and services. Its offerings span loans, fixed deposits, payments, insurance, and mutual funds through its mobile app, website, and social media, and through its branch network.

SBILIFE.about: SBI Life Insurance Company Ltd is engaged in the business of life insurance and annuity. It was started as a Joint-venture between State Bank of India and BNP Paribas Cardif S.A.
SBILIFE.points:
Product Portfolio
The company offers a range of life insurance products, including 25 individual and 8 group plans across protection, pension, savings, and health solutions. Its portfolio includes participating, non-participating, pension, gratuity, leave encashment, superannuation, annuity, unit-linked, variable, health, and micro-insurance products.

TITAN.about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience. It was founded in 1984 as a joint-venture between TATA Group and Tamilnadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO).
TITAN.points:
Part of the Tata Group
The company benefits from its association with the Tata Group, one of India’s most established and diversified business conglomerates. As of FY26, the Tata Group held a 25% stake in the company, including a 21% shareholding through Tata Sons Pvt Ltd., while Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Corporation Limited (TIDCO) held 28%.

PAGEIND.about: Incorporated in 1995, Page Industries Limited is the exclusive licensee of JOCKEY International Inc. for manufacturing, distribution, and marketing of the JOCKEY® brand in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, and the UAE. Page Industries is also the exclusive licensee of Speedo International Ltd. for the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of the Speedo brand in India.
PAGEIND.points:
Brand & Product Portfolio
a)Jockey
Jockey, a globally recognized brand present in over 147 countries, operates in India and select neighboring markets through an exclusive licensing agreement. Page Industries has rights to manufacture, distribute, and market Jockey products in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, Oman, Qatar, Maldives, Bhutan, and the UAE. In FY25, it got rights for Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Kuwait too.

BATAINDIA.about: Bata India is primarily engaged in the business of manufacturing and trading of footwear and accessories through its retail and wholesale network.
BATAINDIA.points:
Parentage
As of Sep 2025, the Bata Corporation holds a 50% stake in the company. Founded in 1894 in the Czech Republic, Bata Corporation is the world's leading shoemaker by volume having a retail presence of over 5,300 shops in more than 70 countries across 5 continents, and operates 21 production facilities in 18 countries.

RELAXO.about: Incorporated in 1984, Relaxo Footwear Ltd. is the largest footwear manufacturer in India.
RELAXO.points:
Market Position
Relaxo Footwears Limited is one of the largest footwear manufacturers in India, with over four decades of presence in the industry and ranking among the top 500 most valuable companies.
It is known for offering quality and affordable products across categories including slippers, sandals, and sports & casual footwear.

TRENT.about: Trent Ltd is engaged in retailing of apparels, footwear, accessories, toys, games, food, grocery & non food products through various of its retail formats/ concepts.
TRENT.points:
Part of Tata Group
The company is a part of the Tata Group with ~37% of group shareholding, 32.5% with Tata Sons Private Ltd & 4.3% with Tata Investment Corporation Ltd. Tata Group comprises 100 operating companies in 7 business sectors. The group operates in over 80 countries across 6 continents.

JUBLFOOD.about: Jubilant FoodWorks Limited (JFL/Company) is part of the Jubilant Bhartia Group and is one of the India’s largest food service Company. The Company holds the master franchise rights for two international brands, Domino’s Pizza and Popeyes in its food segment. The Company also launched its first homegrown brand – Hong’s Kitchen in Chinese cuisine segment.
JUBLFOOD.points:
Brand Portfolio
1) Domino’s: The company is a leading player in the pizza segment, holding exclusive rights to operate Domino’s Pizza outlets in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia.
2) Popeyes: It exclusively operates Popeyes in India. Popeyes is the world’s 2nd-largest chicken QSR, offering Louisiana-style Cajun fried chicken and chicken sandwiches.
3) Dunkin’: The company holds exclusive rights to develop and operate Dunkin' restaurants in India, the largest coffee and donut brand in the USA, serving coffee and baked goods.
4) Hong’s Kitchen: Hong’s Kitchen is the company’s first homegrown brand and India’s only Chinese QSR.
5) COFFY: Through the acquisition of DP Eurasia, the company has entered Turkey’s high-frequency coffee consumption market under the “COFFY” brand, which ranks as the 8th largest café brand in Turkey.

INDHOTEL.about: IHCL is one of India’s leading hospitality companies. IHCL and its subsidiaries comprise diversified portfolio across luxury, upscale/upper upscale and lean luxury/midscale segments. IHCL’s operations are spread across four continents, 12 countries and over 100 cities.
INDHOTEL.points:
Hotels Portfolio
As of Aug'31, company has 565+ operational hotels with a total inventory of 57,000+ rooms. It also has a pipeline of 92 hotels with 12,953 rooms increasing the Taj (26 hotels with 4611 rooms), Vivanta (27 hotels with 3,797 rooms), SeleQtions (13 hotels with 1,518 rooms) and Ginger (26 hotels with 3,027 rooms) portfolios
Company opened total 20 hotels with 650 rooms in Q4FY24: 3 SeleQtions (256 rooms) , 1 Vivanta hotel (48 rooms) under Mangement contracts, 2 ginger hotel (155 rooms) under ownership and 14 Tree of life resorts (191 rooms) under sales & distribution agreement.
Company Signed 53 hotel in FY24 and opened 34 hotels.

HAL.about:
Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL), a 71.64% Government-owned Maha-Ratna
CPSE, designs, manufactures,
upgrades and provides lifecycle
MRO for aircraft, helicopters, aero
-engines, avionics /accessories
and aerostructures, principally
for India’s armed forces.
HAL.points:
Business Segments
1) Manufacturing
The five-complex model covers:
1) Fixed-wing aircraft: LCA Tejas, Su-30MKI, Do/Hindustan-228, HTT-40 and legacy fleets
2) ⁠Helicopters: ALH/Dhruv-NG, LCH, LUH, Cheetah/Chetak and future IMRH/DBMRH
3) AL-31FP, RD-33 and Shakti engines
4) Avionics, LRUs and accessories
5) Aerostructures, castings and forgings
6) Aircraft, rotorcraft, UAV, engine and airborne-system R&D

BEL.about: Incorporated in 1954, Bharat Electronics Ltd manufactures and supplies electronic equipment and systems to the defence sector. Company also has a limited presence in the civilian market
BEL.points:
Business Segments
a) Defence (88% in FY26 vs 90% in FY25): The company is a leading defence electronics and aerospace player, providing a range of advanced products, systems, and solutions to the Indian Armed Forces, with core capabilities across Electronic Warfare & Avionics, Communication, Radar & Fire Control, Weapon Systems, C4I, Anti-Submarine Warfare, Tank & Gun Upgrades, Electro-optic Systems, and Arms & Ammunition. It operates through 30 Strategic Business Units (SBUs).

PIDILITIND.about: Pidilite Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer of adhesives and sealants, construction chemicals, craftsmen products, DIY products and polymer emulsions in India. Most of the products have been developed through strong in-house R&D. Our brand name Fevicol has become synonymous with adhesives to millions in India and is ranked amongst the most trusted brands in the country. Some of our other major brands are M-Seal, Fevikwik, Fevistik, Roff, Dr. Fixit, Fevicryl, Motomax, Hobby Ideas, Araldite.
PIDILITIND.points:
Revenue Breakup
Company earns about 53% of its revenues from adhesives & sealants category, followed by Construction & paint chemicals (20%), industrial resins & construction chemicals (7%), art & craft materials (6%), industrial adhesives (6%), and pigment & preparation (6%)..
It has its business divided into 2 divisions, consumer & bazaar products which account for ~80% of revenues, and B2B products segment which accounts for ~20% of revenues In total,the company produces ~650
products for its brands.

UPL.about: UPL is principally engaged in the business of agrochemicals, industrial chemicals, chemical intermediates, speciality chemicals and production and sale of field crops and vegetable seeds.
UPL.points:
Business Overview
UPL is a leading provider of agricultural solutions and services, with 14,000+ product registrations, a presence in ~140 countries, access to 90% of the world’s food basket. The products include Crop Protection Chemicals like Insecticides, Fungicides, Herbicides etc. also Seeds, Biosolutions. It is a 5th largest Agrochemical company globally with 43 manufacturing facilities across the globe.

CHAMBLFERT.about:
Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd is engaged in production of Urea from its own manufacturing plants. It also markets/ deals in other fertilisers and agri-inputs. It also has a Joint Venture for manufacture of Phospohric Acid in Morocco.
The company was also engaged in Software business, However, in FY21, it sold assets and transferred certain liabilities of the business to cease the operations of the software business.
CHAMBLFERT.points:
Business Overview:
Company is engaged in manufacturing
Urea. It is also engaged in marketing of
other fertilisers such as Di-Ammonium
Phosphate (DAP), Muriate of Potash
(MOP), NPK fertilisers, Speciality Plant
Nutrients and Crop Protection Chemicals. Through JV it is engaged in the manufacture
of phosphoric acid in Morocco.

BALRAMCHIN.about: Balrampur Chini Mills Limited (BCML) is one of the largest integrated sugar companies in India. The allied businesses of the Company comprise distillery operations and cogeneration of power.
BALRAMCHIN.points:
Business Segments
The company is one of the largest integrated sugar companies in India, with allied businesses in distillery operations and co-generation of power.

VBL.about:
Varun Beverages Ltd has been associated with PepsiCo since the 1990s and is a key player in beverage industry and one of the largest franchisee of PepsiCo in the world. The company produces and distributes a wide range of carbonated soft drinks, non-carbonated drinks and packaged water sold under trademarks owned by PepsiCo.
PepsiCo brands produced and sold by the company include Pepsi, Seven-up, Mirinda Orange, Mountain Dew, Tropicana Juices and many more.
VBL.points:
Brand Portfolio:
The company is a key player in the beverage industry and one of the largest franchisees of PepsiCo in the world (outside the USA). It produces and distributes a range of carbonated soft drinks (CSDs), as well as a selected non-carbonated beverage (NCBs), including packaged drinking water sold under trademarks owned by PepsiCo.

UBL.about: United Breweries Limited (UBL) is engaged in the business of manufacture and sale of beer and non-alcoholic beverages.
UBL.points:
Brand Portfolio:
United Breweries Ltd. is India’s largest beer manufacturer and forms part of the HEINEKEN group. Its portfolio spans mainstream, premium and super-premium offerings led by Kingfisher, Kingfisher Ultra, Ultra Max, Heineken, Heineken Silver and Amstel. Regional brands include UB Export, London Pilsner, Bullet and Kalyani Black Label. In FY26, the company has 207 million cases sold, 28 products, 13 brands and exports to 50+ markets.

PVRINOX.about:
PVR Limited (PVR) is India’s largest and most premium film exhibition company. It pioneered the multiplex revolution in India by establishing the first multiplex cinema in 1997 at New Delhi and continues to lead the market with relentless focus on innovation and operational excellence to democratise big‑screen movie experience.
It currently operates a cinema network of 1763 screens across 111 cities and 355 cinemas with ~1.8 lakh seats.
PVRINOX.points:
Revenue Breakup (FY22)
The company earns about 52% of its revenues from the sale of movie tickets. It also earns revenues from other activities like the sale of food & beverages contributed 30% to its revenues, followed by advertisement income (6%), Convenience fees (6%) & other business (6%)

VIPIND.about: VIP Industries is engaged interalia, in the business of manufacturing and marketing of luggage, bags and accessories.
VIPIND.points:
Market Leadership:
The company is Asia’s leading and the world’s 2nd-largest manufacturer and retailer of luggage, backpacks, and handbags. It is a leader in the organized and oligopolistic Indian luggage market with a ~38% market share.
